quest.title: Radiant Sparks
quest.description: During Lantern Rite, Tiantian, a recruiter for the Adventurers' Guild, is eagerly rubbing her hands together in anticipation of an interesting event...

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Hey! Happy Lantern Rite, esteemed ones!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: You guys have been having fun? How about going on a special adventure with me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, you called us "esteemed ones"! Such a great attitude!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Recently, we've been having a lot of fun! But... why is Paimon getting a strange feeling that we've met before?

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: You guys are extremely diligent adventurers, so I'm sure we've bumped into each other at some point!

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: I'm Tiantian. I usually hang out around the Feiyun Slope, looking to recruit new people into the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Tiantian
dialogues.text: Everyone and their cats and dogs passing by have probably heard my voice!

choices.text: You do look a bit familiar...

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Yes! It means my efforts were noticed by you guys! All the more reason for you to experience my masterpiece!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At this point, of course we'll lend you a hand!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can you tell us a little bit about your particular adventure?

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Sure, then I'll cut to the chase!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Recently I came across a new novel at the Wanwen Bookhouse... no, that's not it. Rather, I gathered some new information!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: I've noticed that people's expectations for adventure are rising and activities such as climbing and wind gliding are not as exciting as they used to be.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: In order to get more people to join the Adventurers' Guild, we need to come up with more novel and exciting approaches.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: So, I teamed up with a couple of other recruiters, pooled together our resources, consulted a few expert mountain climbers and fireworks craftsmen, and designed a new racing challenge!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: There are many mechanisms laid out in the challenge. Just step on them and use the momentum from the fireworks and gunpowder blasts to accelerate into the sky!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fireworks? Gunpowder!? So for the challenge, you want to... blast people into the sky!?!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why are you so excited? You're also going up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Although with your strength, an explosive barrel bursting in front of you wouldn't faze you... but who knows? It just might blow you away!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Not to worry. The explosion is contained inside a tough device. I've taken the necessary precautions to make sure it's safe and injury-free!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: I've also filed a patent with the Ministry of Civil Affairs and have publicized this event many times. Please do not steal my idea!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are so many hurdles! You've really put a lot of thought into this!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: As far as I can tell, just doing this racing challenge will stir the spirit of adventure even in an average passerby!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Esteemed ones, your reputation precedes you. If you guys take point on this racing challenge, you'll be sure to attract a lot of people.

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: I have also prepared great rewards for the challenge. They'll be sure to encourage more people to join the Adventurers' Guild!

choices.text: Okay, firework and gunpowder race, let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! There's no reason we shouldn't do this if there are rewards to obtain!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Then it's a deal! Without further ado, please give it a whirl!

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Hehe, there are a lot of tracks for you to try. I'm sure you'll have a good time with them, and I'll get a couple months' worth of results. It's a win-win!

choices.text: Oh boy, time for Paimon and me to get blown sky high!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, Paimon sees you laughing! As Tiantian said, it's perfectly safe. Don't you want to give it a try?

response.speaker: Tiantian
response.text: Doesn't ring a bell? Then I shall make a bigger impression with this masterpiece... No, I shall do it to recruit more people into the Adventurers' Guild.
